verdict.rationale: The evidence points to portability rather than showing it directly. n8n can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure (n8n-docs-3, n8n-docs-29), and workflows can be pushed and pulled through Git source control (n8n-docs-7, n8n-docs-22). An n8n API (n8n-docs-16) and an official CLI (n8n-docs-17, n8n-probe-4) also exist and could plausibly be used to extract data. However, no item explicitly documents a full data export, the file formats involved, or a migration-off path, and Git version control appears only as a pricing-page feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exporting workflows, credentials and execution data in open formats (e.g. JSON); evidence that export covers all data; an offboarding or migration guide; independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful export.
